items.question: Which invoked power is asked to protect the practitioner's head and all limbs?
premises: Kāmā and associated powers are invoked as protectors.
The invoked power is addressed as Svāhā, the crusher.
Protection is explicitly requested for the head and all limbs.
items.inference: The practitioner seeks comprehensive bodily protection from the power invoked as Kāmā-led Svāhā.
uncertainties: The exact group denoted by kāmādyā is not specified in this verse alone.
items.plain_english: May Kāmā and the others, Svāhā the crusher, protect me—my head and all my limbs.
